bboxNote: The bounding box of Rock Island County, IL from the US Census TIGERweb county layer. It is a rectangle, so it also covers neighbouring ground — including part of Scott County, Iowa across the Mississippi. Infrastructure outside the county line is kept, because a site's nearest substation does not stop at a county boundary.

categories.label: Electric substations
categories.note: Drawn at each substation's centre point. OpenStreetMap maps most substations as an area; the centre point is used so they stay legible at county zoom.

categories.label: Transmission lines
categories.note: power=line only. power=minor_line (low-voltage distribution) and power=tower (pylons) are excluded — neither is transmission infrastructure a data-centre site is assessed against.

categories.label: Available interconnection capacity (MW) per substation
categories.checked: OpenStreetMap: none of the substation features in this snapshot carry any capacity, rating, MVA or load tag. HIFLD Open (GeoPlatform ArcGIS org Hp6G80Pky0om7QvQ): 0 of 526 published services have a name matching /substation/i — HIFLD's substations layer is not in the public catalogue, and HIFLD Secure (gii.dhs.gov) is login-gated.
categories.note: No public source found for Rock Island County. Not shown, and not estimated.

crossCheck.source: HIFLD Open — Electric Power Transmission Lines
crossCheck.note: An independent federal source covering the same box. The two feature counts are not comparable — HIFLD publishes one feature per circuit run while OpenStreetMap splits a way wherever its tags change. Cited as corroboration that transmission lines exist here, never as a coverage measure.
crossCheck.licenseNote: The HIFLD service publishes no copyrightText and has no ArcGIS Online item carrying licence terms, so its geometry is not redistributed in this build — only its feature count is cited.
